content:
{
  "project": "hive-research-gpu",
  "what_building": "A GPU-accelerated research assistant that synthesizes academic literature into structured summaries and knowledge graphs. It specifically focuses on complex domains like multi-agent systems and reinforcement learning by processing paper sections and figures.",
  "pipeline": [
    "ingest_paper_metadata",
    "extract_sections_and_figures",
    "generate_section_summaries",
    "synthesize_research_briefing",
    "identify_information_gaps"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "paper_title",
    "paper_content (abstract, experiments, figures)",
    "research_question",
    "numbered_context_excerpts"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "research_briefing",
    "section_summaries",
    "knowledge_graph_nodes",
    "json_search_queries"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.92,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "Title: From Model-Based Screening to Data-Driven Surrogates",
    "Answer using ONLY the numbered context excerpts provided. Cite every claim with its excerpt number",
    "List up to 3 specific information gaps as refined arXiv-style search queries",
    "schema hints: ['abstract', 'brief', 'experimental setup', 'figures available', 'knowledge graph']"
  ]
}
